# TeachEngineering

> > K-12 engineering and science curriculum repository aligned with NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards), featuring hands-on lessons, activities, and units across disciplines including biomedical engineering, physics, renewable energy, and environmental science.

TeachEngineering is a digital library of standards-aligned engineering curricula developed by universities and research institutions. The platform serves educators with ready-to-use lesson plans, curricular units, and hands-on activities that integrate engineering design processes with core STEM subjects for elementary through high school students.

## Key Topics

- NGSS (Next Generation Science Standards)
- Engineering Design Process
- Biomedical Engineering
- Newton's Laws of Motion
- Renewable Energy
- Hands-on Activities
- Middle School Physics
- K-12 Curriculum
- Achievement Standards Network (ASN)
- Physics Education
- Engineering Education
- Environmental Science
- Heat Transfer & Thermodynamics
- Electromagnetics & Waves
- Natural Disasters & Earth Science

## Core Programs & Popular Topics

- [Engineering for US All (e4usa)](http://www.teachengineering.org/e4usa): Engineering for US All (e4usa) K-12 design and making course programs
- [Newton's Laws of Motion](http://www.teachengineering.org/populartopics/view/newtonslaws): K-12 curriculum collection on Newton's laws with hands-on activities

## Curricular Units

- [Natural Disasters: Earthquakes, Volcanoes, Tornadoes & More](https://www.teachengineering.org/curricularunits/view/cub_natdis_curricularunit): Elementary earth science curriculum unit on natural disasters by CU Boulder
- [Conduction, Convection and Radiation](https://www.teachengineering.org/curricularunits/view/duk_heattransfer_smary_unit): Middle school heat transfer unit with hands-on temperature experiments
- [Biodomes](https://www.teachengineering.org/curricularunits/view/cub_bio_curricularunit): Elementary NGSS-aligned unit on ecosystems and biodome design projects
- [Environmental Challenges in China: Rural Villages to Big Cities](https://www.teachengineering.org/curricularunits/view/cub_china_unit): NGSS unit on China's environmental challenges and renewable energy solutions
- [Marine Mapping](https://www.teachengineering.org/curricularunits/view/duk_marine_musc_unit): Marine science curriculum on habitat mapping and animal tracking techniques

## Biomedical Engineering Lessons

- [My Mechanical Ear Can Hear!](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/cub_biomed_lesson06): Middle school biomedical engineering lesson on hearing aids and impairments
- [What Do I Need to Know about Heart Valves?](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/van_floppy_lesson01): High school biomedical engineering lesson on heart valves and dissection
- [Simulation in Healthcare](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/usf_healthcare_lesson01): Grade 5 lesson on engineering design and healthcare simulation modeling

## Physics & Energy Lessons

- [Puttin' It All Together](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/cub_energy_lesson05): Grade 8 physics summary lesson on energy, momentum, and friction concepts
- [What a Drag](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/cub_energy_lesson04): Middle school physics lesson on friction and drag forces in motion
- [Factors Affecting Friction](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/duk_friction_smary_less2): Middle school physics lesson on friction experiments with weight and area
- [Android Acceleration](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/uno_accelerometer_lesson02): High school physics lesson using Android accelerometer and Newton's laws
- [What Does Light See?](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/van_oddsofcancer_lesson02): High school physics lesson on refraction, diffraction, and optical phenomena

## Electromagnetics & Waves

- [Riding the Radio Waves](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/duk_amradio_tech_less): Middle school lesson on AM radio waves and electromagnetic fields
- [Electromagnetic Radiation](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/van_nanoparticles_lesson01): High school lesson on UV radiation, photon energy, and nanoparticles

## Aerospace & Programming

- [Get Me Off This Planet](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/cub_mars_lesson04): Middle school aerospace lesson on rockets and orbital mechanics to Mars
- [Java Code: Does It Work? Test and Test Again](https://www.teachengineering.org/lessons/view/uno_doesitwork_lesson01): High school Java programming lesson on software testing using CodingBat

## Optional Resources

- [Renewable Energy Educators Resources](http://www.teachengineering.org/livinglabs/renewableenergyeducators): K-12 renewable energy curriculum resources from NREL and partners
